Quick update from runtime perf: we confirmed the canary push included qprofile v2.1 for the "payments-v2" variant and the rollout completed across 6 nodes in us-west at ~06:20 PST. Observations so far:

- Token decode latency per-op increased ~18% for sequence lengths >256 (seen in trace spans).
- KV cache hit rate dropped from ~82% to ~44% for ZenithPay's tenant key after the rollout (suspect cache-key fragmentation due to new prefix encoding changes in v2.1).
- Memory spillovers observed on one pod (OOM-killer did not trigger, but GC frequency increased).

I can push an immediate qprofile revert for the payments-v2 variant back to v2.0 (no model weight change, just qprofile selector). That should restore prior decode paths and likely bring p95 back within target in ~20–30m while we validate. If allowed, I will coordinate a quick canary revert and limit broader rollout.

I'll attach the diff we used (qprofile-v2.1-diff.patch) for traceability.

-Rishi
